details: Built and improved digital experiences for ReadyRefresh to support online service scheduling, customer engagement, and streamlined account interactions.
Worked closely with product and design teams to simplify complex workflows while improving usability and conversion outcomes.
Optimized responsive front-end architecture, accessibility, and performance for a better self-service customer journey.
Developed dashboard experiences for U.S. Bank that translated operational data into clear, actionable reporting for business users.
Built reusable UI patterns and API-driven views that improved clarity, speed, and maintainability across financial workflows.
Focused on responsive, accessible interfaces that supported stakeholder decision-making in a highly regulated environment.
